sentences.sentence: A library is an organized collection of books and records kept for reading and loan.
A school is an institution that gathers learners and teachers for formal instruction.
A university is a higher school that grants degrees and supports research.
A government is the set of offices that make and enforce public decisions for a territory.
Democracy is rule in which citizens choose leaders or laws by vote.
A monarchy is a state headed by a hereditary sovereign.
A republic is a state whose head is not a monarch and whose offices are public trusts.
An empire is a state that rules many peoples and lands from one center.
War is organized armed conflict between political groups.
Peace is the absence of war and the presence of a settled political order.
Trade is the exchange of goods and services, usually for money.
Agriculture is the practice of raising crops and livestock for food and materials.
Industry is the organized manufacture of goods from raw materials.
Transport is the movement of people and goods from one place to another.
A ship is a large vessel built to carry people or cargo on water.
An aircraft is a machine that flies by lift from wings or rotors.
A railway is a guided track system for wheeled trains.
A road is a prepared way for vehicles and walkers between places.
A bridge is a structure that carries a path across a gap.
A building is a lasting shelter with walls and a roof.
A house is a building meant as a dwelling for a household.
A temple is a building set apart for worship.
A church is a Christian house of worship and the community that meets there.
A mosque is a Muslim house of prayer.
Ancient Egypt was the Nile civilization known for writing, kingship, and stone monuments.
Mesopotamia was the land between the Tigris and Euphrates where cities and writing arose early.
Ancient Greece was a world of city-states that left philosophy, theater, and political vocabulary.
Rome was the Italian city that built a republic and then an empire around the Mediterranean.
China is the East Asian civilization and state with a long written record and imperial tradition.
India is the South Asian subcontinent and the civilization of its languages, religions, and states.
Islam is the monotheistic religion taught in the Quran and practiced by Muslims.
Christianity is the religion centered on the life and teaching of Jesus of Nazareth.
Judaism is the religion and people of Israel, centered on the Hebrew Bible and later law.
Buddhism is the path taught by the Buddha, aimed at ending suffering.
Hinduism is the family of Indian religious traditions of dharma, ritual, and many schools.
Paper is a thin sheet of plant fiber used for writing and printing.
Ink is a colored liquid used to mark paper or similar surfaces.
An alphabet is a writing system whose signs stand mainly for sounds.
As a written digit, zero holds an empty place so other digits keep their value.
Pi is the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter.
A triangle is a polygon with three sides.
A circle is the set of points in a plane at a fixed distance from a center.
A square is a rectangle with equal sides.
Volume is the measure of space a body occupies.
Mass is the measure of a body's inertia and of its share in gravitation.
Density is mass per unit volume.
Pressure is force per unit area.
A vacuum is a space with far fewer particles than ordinary air.
A star is a self-luminous ball of plasma held by gravity and powered by fusion for most of its life.
A galaxy is a bound system of stars, gas, dust, and dark matter.
